datasets.name: ontario_actual_vs_pred
queryLines:
WITH latest_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    target_datetime,
    predicted_demand_mw,
    prediction_time
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
  WHERE
    zone = 'Ontario'
    AND prediction_time
      = (
        SELECT
          MAX(prediction_time)
        FROM
          workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
        WHERE
          zone = 'Ontario'
      )
),
actuals AS (
  SELECT
    datetime AS target_datetime,
    demand_mw AS actual_demand_mw
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast_bronze.load_zonal
  WHERE
    zone = 'Ontario'
    AND datetime >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 3)
),
time_range AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(
      (
        SELECT
          MIN(target_datetime)
        FROM
          latest_forecast
      ),
      (
        SELECT
          MIN(target_datetime)
        FROM
          actuals
      )
    ) AS min_time,
    GREATEST(
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(target_datetime)
        FROM
          latest_forecast
      ),
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(target_datetime)
        FROM
          actuals
      )
    ) AS max_time
)
SELECT
  f.target_datetime,
  f.predicted_demand_mw AS demand_mw,
  'Prédiction' AS series_type
FROM
  latest_forecast f
UNION ALL
SELECT
  a.target_datetime,
  a.actual_demand_mw AS demand_mw,
  'Réel' AS series_type
FROM
  actuals a
ORDER BY
  target_datetime,
  series_type

datasets.name: shap_top15_7j
queryLines:
SELECT
  feature_name,
  AVG(ABS(shap_value)) AS avg_abs_shap_value
FROM
  workspace.energy_forecast.load_shap_7j
WHERE
  zone = 'Ontario'
  AND prediction_time
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(prediction_time)
      FROM
        workspace.energy_forecast.load_shap_7j
      WHERE
        zone = 'Ontario'
    )
GROUP BY
  feature_name
ORDER BY
  avg_abs_shap_value DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: daily_peak_trough
queryLines:
WITH latest_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    target_datetime,
    predicted_demand_mw,
    prediction_time,
    DATE(target_datetime) AS target_date
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
  WHERE
    zone = 'Ontario'
    AND prediction_time
      = (
        SELECT
          MAX(prediction_time)
        FROM
          workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
        WHERE
          zone = 'Ontario'
      )
),
daily_stats AS (
  SELECT
    target_date,
    MAX(predicted_demand_mw) AS peak_demand_mw,
    MIN(predicted_demand_mw) AS trough_demand_mw,
    AVG(predicted_demand_mw) AS avg_demand_mw,
    MAX(predicted_demand_mw) - MIN(predicted_demand_mw) AS amplitude_mw
  FROM
    latest_forecast
  GROUP BY
    target_date
),
peak_times AS (
  SELECT
    f.target_date,
    MIN(f.target_datetime) AS peak_time
  FROM
    latest_forecast f
      INNER JOIN daily_stats ds
        ON f.target_date = ds.target_date
        AND f.predicted_demand_mw = ds.peak_demand_mw
  GROUP BY
    f.target_date
),
trough_times AS (
  SELECT
    f.target_date,
    MIN(f.target_datetime) AS trough_time
  FROM
    latest_forecast f
      INNER JOIN daily_stats ds
        ON f.target_date = ds.target_date
        AND f.predicted_demand_mw = ds.trough_demand_mw
  GROUP BY
    f.target_date
)
SELECT
  ds.target_date,
  ds.peak_demand_mw,
  pt.peak_time,
  HOUR(pt.peak_time) AS peak_hour,
  ds.trough_demand_mw,
  tt.trough_time,
  HOUR(tt.trough_time) AS trough_hour,
  ds.avg_demand_mw,
  ds.amplitude_mw,
  ROUND(ds.amplitude_mw / ds.avg_demand_mw * 100, 2) AS amplitude_pct
FROM
  daily_stats ds
    INNER JOIN peak_times pt
      ON ds.target_date = pt.target_date
    INNER JOIN trough_times tt
      ON ds.target_date = tt.target_date
ORDER BY
  ds.target_date

datasets.name: peak_trough_series
queryLines:
WITH latest_forecast AS (
  SELECT
    target_datetime,
    predicted_demand_mw,
    prediction_time,
    DATE(target_datetime) AS target_date
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
  WHERE
    zone = 'Ontario'
    AND prediction_time
      = (
        SELECT
          MAX(prediction_time)
        FROM
          workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
        WHERE
          zone = 'Ontario'
      )
),
daily_stats AS (
  SELECT
    target_date,
    MAX(predicted_demand_mw) AS peak_demand_mw,
    MIN(predicted_demand_mw) AS trough_demand_mw,
    AVG(predicted_demand_mw) AS avg_demand_mw
  FROM
    latest_forecast
  GROUP BY
    target_date
)
SELECT
  target_date,
  'Pic' AS type_demande,
  peak_demand_mw AS demand_mw
FROM
  daily_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
  target_date,
  'Creux' AS type_demande,
  trough_demand_mw AS demand_mw
FROM
  daily_stats
ORDER BY
  target_date,
  type_demande

datasets.name: peak_trough_hours
queryLines:
WITH daily_peak_trough AS (
  WITH latest_forecast AS (
    SELECT
      target_datetime,
      predicted_demand_mw,
      prediction_time,
      DATE(target_datetime) AS target_date
    FROM
      workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
    WHERE
      zone = 'Ontario'
      AND prediction_time
        = (
          SELECT
            MAX(prediction_time)
          FROM
            workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
          WHERE
            zone = 'Ontario'
        )
  ),
  daily_stats AS (
    SELECT
      target_date,
      MAX(predicted_demand_mw) AS peak_demand_mw,
      MIN(predicted_demand_mw) AS trough_demand_mw
    FROM
      latest_forecast
    GROUP BY
      target_date
  ),
  peak_times AS (
    SELECT
      f.target_date,
      MIN(f.target_datetime) AS peak_time
    FROM
      latest_forecast f
        INNER JOIN daily_stats ds
          ON f.target_date = ds.target_date
          AND f.predicted_demand_mw = ds.peak_demand_mw
    GROUP BY
      f.target_date
  ),
  trough_times AS (
    SELECT
      f.target_date,
      MIN(f.target_datetime) AS trough_time
    FROM
      latest_forecast f
        INNER JOIN daily_stats ds
          ON f.target_date = ds.target_date
          AND f.predicted_demand_mw = ds.trough_demand_mw
    GROUP BY
      f.target_date
  )
  SELECT
    HOUR(pt.peak_time) AS peak_hour,
    HOUR(tt.trough_time) AS trough_hour
  FROM
    daily_stats ds
      INNER JOIN peak_times pt
        ON ds.target_date = pt.target_date
      INNER JOIN trough_times tt
        ON ds.target_date = tt.target_date
)
SELECT
  'Pic' as type_demande,
  peak_hour as hour_value
FROM
  daily_peak_trough
WHERE
  peak_hour IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Creux' as type_demande,
  trough_hour as hour_value
FROM
  daily_peak_trough
WHERE
  trough_hour IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: peak_consumption
queryLines:
SELECT
  target_datetime AS peak_datetime,
  demand_mw AS peak_value
FROM
  workspace.energy_forecast.ontario_actual_vs_pred
WHERE
  demand_mw
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(demand_mw)
      FROM
        workspace.energy_forecast.ontario_actual_vs_pred
    )
LIMIT 1

datasets.name: shap_diff_pic_creux
queryLines:
WITH daily_peaks_troughs AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(target_datetime) as target_date,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN predicted_demand_mw = max_demand THEN target_datetime
      END
    ) as peak_datetime,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN predicted_demand_mw = min_demand THEN target_datetime
      END
    ) as trough_datetime
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
          DATE(target_datetime) as dt,
          MAX(predicted_demand_mw) as max_demand,
          MIN(predicted_demand_mw) as min_demand
        FROM
          workspace.energy_forecast.load_forecast_7j
        WHERE
          zone = 'Ontario'
        GROUP BY
          DATE(target_datetime)
      ) daily_stats
  WHERE
    DATE(target_datetime) = dt
    AND zone = 'Ontario'
  GROUP BY
    DATE(target_datetime)
),
peak_shap AS (
  SELECT
    s.feature_name,
    AVG(s.shap_value) as shap_pic
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast.load_shap_7j s
      INNER JOIN daily_peaks_troughs pt
        ON s.target_datetime = pt.peak_datetime
  WHERE
    s.zone = 'Ontario'
  GROUP BY
    s.feature_name
),
trough_shap AS (
  SELECT
    s.feature_name,
    AVG(s.shap_value) as shap_creux
  FROM
    workspace.energy_forecast.load_shap_7j s
      INNER JOIN daily_peaks_troughs pt
        ON s.target_datetime = pt.trough_datetime
  WHERE
    s.zone = 'Ontario'
  GROUP BY
    s.feature_name
)
SELECT
  p.feature_name,
  p.shap_pic,
  t.shap_creux,
  (p.shap_pic - t.shap_creux) as shap_diff,
  ABS(p.shap_pic - t.shap_creux) as abs_shap_diff
FROM
  peak_shap p
    INNER JOIN trough_shap t
      ON p.feature_name = t.feature_name
ORDER BY
  abs_shap_diff DESC
